# Kapiree

> Kapiree is an all-in-one HRMS (human resource management system) and people and work management platform for small and medium-sized businesses. It brings attendance, leave, projects, meetings, payroll, performance, incentives and an AI Assistant into one platform, with an optional AI-powered Hiring add-on for video interviews and pre-screening.

Key facts:
- Audience: growing small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), HR teams, managers and employees.
- Pricing: free trial (₹0, no payment required); HRMS subscription ₹110 per employee per month, billed monthly or annually; Hiring add-on ₹2,250 per month, available after subscribing to the HRMS.
- Employees get their own login for attendance, leave, payslips and self-service HR. Access is role-based.
- The AI Assistant answers everyday HR questions in natural language, e.g. leave balance, who is on leave, attendance, payslips and policies.
- Sign up: https://hrm.neointeraction.com/signup · Log in: https://hrm.neointeraction.com/login · Contact: info@kapiree.com

## HRMS modules
- Attendance & Time Tracking: employees clock in/out and view timesheets; managers review and approve attendance requests.
- Leave Management: employees apply for and track leave; managers approve; includes leave policies and holiday calendar.
- People & Work Management: create, track and manage projects assigned to employees or teams, with project details (tasks, timeline, members).
- Meetings: schedule, view and manage internal meetings, notes and agendas.
- Payroll & Payslips: payroll processing, salary adjustments, payroll reports and employee payslip access.
- Performance Engine: review cycles, goal setting (OKRs), 1:1 check-ins, reviews and calibration.
- Incentives: manage employee incentive programs and bonus payouts.
- AI Assistant: conversational assistant for quick HR answers and routine tasks.

## Hiring add-on
- AI video interviews and automated pre-screening; recruiters can review 10x more candidates and reduce time-to-hire by up to 50%.
- Job management, candidate management, applicant tracking, candidate pipeline, interview management, hiring workflows, offer management.
- AI interview analysis (confidence, clarity, relevance), AI transcripts, multilingual interviews, custom questions, website career-page integration and API integration.
- Monthly AI credits included; additional credits can be purchased.
